title: boot: a packages[] stack's top-level `datasets` item that no package body declares is dropped with no refusal and no registration
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbahe4v7GBD94QeSnir

Filing gate: ① product defect, `finding` class a, from the out-of-scope finding of the os-dev report 6583541780 on #29335 (PR #29514). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no lane: triage sets both (the read points at `domain:server`: `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`).
Reader who acts: the lane triage assigns; the fix lands in the boot registrar.
Business reason: an author who ships a multi-package artifact with a dataset at the stack's top level gets no dataset and no message. A dashboard or report naming it then fails at run time far from the cause. ADR-0130 D4's residual rule exists so that a top-level item is either registered or refused, never silently lost.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "residual datasets" 44 hits, "unclaimedTopLevel datasets" 2, "ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE datasets" 5, "top-level datasets dropped" 31; none but #29335 (the docblock half, which triage scoped out of this) describes this drop. **New.**
reach: measured once on a kernel boot (`ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, `manifest.register(stack)`), the registrar a config boot hands a `packages[]` stack to. No HTTP door was driven. Read, not run: the analytics query route resolves a saved `datasetName` through `getMetaItems` type `dataset`, so it would answer 404 for such an item.

## What was measured (tree `94d3e254`)

Probe stack: `packages[]` with a service body declaring `datasets: [body_ds]` and an app body, plus top-level `datasets: [body_ds, residual_ds]` and top-level `dashboards: [residual_dash]`.

- `unclaimedTopLevel(stack).items` = `[dashboards[0] residual_dash]`; no `datasets` entry, because `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` has no `datasets` row.
- After `manifest.register(stack)`: nothing thrown. `registry.listItems('dataset')` = `[body_ds]`. `registry.listItems('dashboard')` includes `residual_dash` (positive control: a mapped residual collection is registered). `registry.getItem('dataset', 'residual_ds')` = `null`. No warn or error line names `residual_ds` or `datasets`.
- The probe was a scratch vitest file under `packages/objectql`, deleted after the run; the full reading is in 6583541780.

## Wanted

Either register a residual top-level `datasets` item like the other residual collections, or refuse it at both doors (build and boot) with a named error. Measure on a built boot first; if the drop is ruled acceptable, write that down where the rule lives instead.

## Same wrong attribution, for whoever fixes this

`scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs`, the `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` waiver row for `datasets`, `jobs`, `datasources` and `translations`, says all four are "consumed functionally by AppPlugin straight off the bundle". For `datasets` that is not so (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` reads none; PR #29514 corrects the same sentence in `stack.zod.ts`). The fix to this card changes that row anyway, so the row's text rides it.

Related: #29335 / PR #29514, #28695 (the build door's residual walk).
